title.narrative: Infrastructure facility for waste storage in Kosovo

description.narrative: The project refers to the development of one (1) sanitary landfill (SL) in North Kosovo. The new landfill will serve the Municipalities of Leposaviq / Leposavić, Mitrovicë / Mitrovica (north), Zveçan / Zvečane, and Zubin Potok.This project will implement the priority of measures aiming the reducing of severe local pollution or of those ones which may affect the human health.
